summary: All 3 tests failed in the Product Overview suite. Failures are related to missing elements on the page and a test timeout.
rootCause: The tests failed because key UI elements identified by data-testid selectors were not found or visible on the page, causing assertions to fail or time out.

failedTests.testName: TC-001 - Verify grid of product cards is displayed on home page
failedTests.errorMessage: expect(locator('[data-testid="product-grid"]')).toBeVisible() failed: element(s) not found within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: The selector '[data-testid="product-grid"]' did not match any elements on the page, indicating either the element is missing or the selector is incorrect.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the product grid element exists on the page and that the data-testid attribute is correct. If the application changed, update the selector accordingly.

failedTests.testName: TC-002 - Verify product card details are displayed
failedTests.likelyCause: No product cards were found on the page, likely because the selector for product cards did not match any elements or the page did not load expected data.
failedTests.recommendation: Check if the product cards are rendered on the page and the selector used to locate them is correct. Confirm that test data is present and the page loaded successfully.

failedTests.testName: TC-003 - Verify navigation to product detail page from product card
failedTests.errorMessage: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded while waiting for product name element inside the first product card.
failedTests.likelyCause: The locator for the product name inside the first product card did not find the element, possibly due to missing product cards or incorrect selectors.
failedTests.recommendation: Ensure that product cards and their child elements exist and selectors are accurate. Investigate if the page is loading slowly or if there is a blocking issue preventing rendering.

recommendations: Validate that the application under test is correctly rendering the product grid and product cards with the expected data-testid attributes.
Review and update selectors in the tests to match the current application DOM structure.
Confirm that the test environment is stable and the application is fully loaded before assertions.
Check if any recent application changes affected the UI elements targeted by the tests.
Consider adding waits or retries if the page load is slow or asynchronous data loading affects element availability.
releaseImpact: High - All tests in the Product Overview suite failed, blocking verification of critical UI components and navigation flows.
